name: r-gatekeeper
description: Type-safe input/output gates for your handlers, powered by Zod.

scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -S -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag -s v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -S -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag -s v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -S -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag -s v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push --follow-tags
